gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-mro: Cosmic ribbons of constant width: that is Galaxy, spaced loosely and drawn with one unbroken line. Noto Sans Mro stays compact and tall through the middle of its words, with generous entrances into each letter.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-multani: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy draws every letter in one unbroken line, with thin joins no lighter than the stems. Noto Sans Multani, lofty with an open e, reads smoothly page after page.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Galaxy spaces its cosmic letters loosely, with every diagonal carrying as much heft as the stems. Galaxy makes the statement; Noto Sans Myanmar does the sturdy, welcoming text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Commanding and loosely spaced, Galaxy keeps its line uniform all around, with no swelling where curves meet stems. Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost cap-tall and reads briskly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-nag-munda: Crisp and tall in the lowercase, Noto Sans Nag Mundari leaves its curves half unwrapped. Galaxy, ruler-straight and cosmic in its constant line, is best given room to look commanding.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-nandinaga: Galaxy draws every curve without any stress, one unbroken line. Noto Sans Nandinagari, approachable with short ascenders and a big lowercase body, keeps its openings generous so paragraphs read comfortably.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa reads brightly, with a clearly open mouth on its e. Galaxy does the loud work, stems like dowels and arcs like bent ones, while the body simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Galaxy draws every letter with a steady, marker-like line, loosely spaced, giving its headings a cosmic, commanding stance. Noto Sans Ogham keeps its tall lowercase clean and bold across many lines.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Words set as solid blocks, their curve tails held well back, read cleanly beneath Galaxy's loose, cosmic lines. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds steady, but shrink the heading and Galaxy loses its commanding presence.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-old-hunga: Cosmic loudness comes from Galaxy, whose line has no thick-thin pulse to carry the eye along. Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its counters open at tiny sizes, the pairing's best single quality.
